title: Gaussian density under noise decomposition
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, and let $\rho,s\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $s\ne0$ and $s^2+\rho^2=1$. For all $x,y\in\mathbb R^n$, the product of the Gaussian densities with means $\rho x_i$ and variance $s^2$, evaluated at $y_i$, equals
\[\left(\frac{\sqrt{2\pi}}{\sqrt{2\pi s^2}}\right)^n\exp\!\left(\frac{1}{2}\sum_i x_i^2\right)\exp\!\left(-\frac{1}{2}\sum_i\left(\frac{x_i-\rho y_i}{s}\right)^2\right)\prod_i p_1(0,y_i),\]
where $p_1(0,y_i)$ is the standard Gaussian density at $y_i$.
